phases.action: scan stale exact-owned ephemeral roots; unknown and active-owner roots remain protected
phases.blocking: only ownership conflict or projected insufficient local space

phases.action: incremental space/object scan only; no full-workspace delete
phases.blocking: only projected peak exceeds available space after all already-approved safe cleanup

phases.action: retire rebuildable staging/extract/duplicate local copies after canonical managed package exists
phases.blocking: never revoke current admitted package; mark CLEANUP_PENDING before another same-kind build

phases.action: retain MAX_PROGRESS + LATEST_1 + LATEST_2, core reports and protected blocker anchors; retire other heavy/extracted copies

phases.action: emit cleanup receipt or explicit CLEANUP_PENDING and exact protected reason
